### Meaning
| infl.      | class        | meaning |

| ~          | *n.*         | heart   |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
oracle bone script of 心
#### Sound
- Maltese "qalb", (qa + n)
- *a priori:* q=beating, an=bodily
- *imitative of:* a heart beating
- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Concepts/qa\|qa]] (life)
